modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Every FlySafair fare includes one free carry-on bag.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Carry-on dimensions should not exceed 56cm x 36cm x 23cm and it must fit in the cabin storage compartment.

carryon_weight.value: Carry-on weight up to 7kg; on the Lite Fare, a carry-on over 7kg is charged an extra R375 at the airport.

personal_item.value: One personal item, either a slimline laptop bag or a handbag (not both), up to 40cm x 15cm x 20cm, which must fit under the seat in front.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Checked luggage is bought separately and is cheaper online.

first_bag_fee.value: A 20kg checked bag costs R185 online (at booking or via Manage Booking) or R375 through the call centre or at the airport.

extra_bag_fee.value: An extra 20kg suitcase costs R250 online or at the airport, only if you already have checked luggage on the booking.

size_weight.value: Checked bags: max 20kg and 90 x 75 x 43 cm. Bags over 20kgs pay a fixed heavy luggage fee of R250 per piece at the airport; any bag over 32kg must go as cargo.

lite_fare.value: FlySafair's basic Lite Fare includes one free carry-on bag up to 7kg and no checked-in luggage.
